description: This header defines classes and structures for tracking and analyzing video rendering quality metrics, including frame timing, freeze and judder events, and frame rate detection, within the Android media framework.

classes.name: VideoRenderQualityMetrics
classes.description: Stores various metrics related to video rendering quality, such as frame rates, freeze and judder scores, and event counts.

classes.name: VideoRenderQualityTracker
classes.description: Analyzes timestamps related to video frames to compute quality metrics, detect freezes and judders, and maintain rendering statistics.

classes.name: VideoRenderQualityTracker::Configuration
classes.description: Holds configurable parameters for the quality tracking algorithms, such as thresholds and histogram buckets.

classes.name: VideoRenderQualityTracker::FreezeEvent
classes.description: Represents a freeze event with details like duration, count, and timestamps.

classes.name: VideoRenderQualityTracker::JudderEvent
classes.description: Represents a judder event with details like duration, score, and timestamps.

classes.name: VideoRenderQualityTracker::FreezeEvent::Details
classes.description: Contains detailed arrays of freeze durations and distances for a freeze event.

classes.name: VideoRenderQualityTracker::JudderEvent::Details
classes.description: Contains detailed arrays of actual and content render durations, and distances for a judder event.

methods.name: void clear()
methods.description: Resets all metrics to initial state.

methods.name: VideoRenderQualityTracker()
methods.description: Default constructor for the quality tracker.

methods.name: void onTunnelFrameQueued(int64_t contentTimeUs)
methods.description: Called when a tunnel mode frame is queued.

methods.name: void onFrameSkipped(int64_t contentTimeUs)
methods.description: Called when a frame is intentionally skipped.

methods.name: void onFrameReleased(int64_t contentTimeUs)
methods.description: Called when a frame is requested to be rendered immediately.

methods.name: void onFrameReleased(int64_t contentTimeUs, int64_t desiredRenderTimeNs)
methods.description: Called when a frame is requested to be rendered at a specific future time.

methods.name: void onFrameRendered(int64_t contentTimeUs, int64_t actualRenderTimeNs, FreezeEvent *freezeEventOut = nullptr, JudderEvent *judderEventOut = nullptr)
methods.description: Called when a frame has been rendered; detects freeze and judder events.

methods.name: FreezeEvent getAndResetFreezeEvent()
methods.description: Retrieves and resets current freeze event data.

methods.name: JudderEvent getAndResetJudderEvent()
methods.description: Retrieves and resets current judder event data.

methods.name: void resetForDiscontinuity()
methods.description: Resets internal state due to content discontinuity.

methods.name: void clear()
methods.description: Clears all tracking data and metrics.
